sanchi_2018.description: MT Sanchi tanker collision (6 Jan 2018) and sinking (14 Jan 2018), East China Sea. Confirmed oil/condensate slicks reported by China's State Oceanic Administration and tracked via VIIRS/Sentinel-2 through mid-to-late January 2018, centered near 28.37N 125.92E.

novorossiysk_2024.description: Caspian Pipeline Consortium (CPC) marine terminal, Black Sea, near Novorossiysk, Russia -- loading-hose rupture during tanker loading on 29 August 2024. Independently confirmed via direct Sentinel satellite image analysis (Greenpeace): ~50 sq km slick on 29 Aug, growing to ~80 sq km on 30 Aug, drifting from the terminal into open Black Sea water, contained west of Anapa. Good control properties: simple single coastline (no archipelago/island clusters), moderate slick size, recent enough for solid CDSE archive coverage.

bay_of_biscay_control.description: Open-water control scene, central Bay of Biscay -- roughly 150-250km offshore from both the French and Spanish coasts. NOT a known spill location; a clean baseline to check whether elongated false-positive regions still occur far from any coastline.
